## Decision 6 ruling (operator-approved 2026-08-30): split — land (a) here now, defer (b)

**This ticket is now scoped to option (a) only: bound `anthropic` in `pyproject.toml`.** It is the portable, minimal fix and is entirely outside epic `financial-stoneware-brant` (eb64-844b-ab7a-4915) scope, so it can land immediately and turn the red mirror-sweep legs green without waiting on the epic.

**Rationale:** The declared constraint currently lies about a *known* incompatibility that `uv.lock` masks — the recognized "works on my lockfile" anti-pattern (cf. the ecosystem `urllib3<2` and `pydantic<2` caps; pydantic-ai itself pins an explicit `anthropic` range). Making the declared bound honest is the correct fix and is what the unlocked sweep legs actually test.

**Implementation note for the fix:** bound `anthropic` with a compatible **range** (floor *and* ceiling), not just a ceiling. The `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` leg uses `--resolution lowest-direct`; adding a direct `anthropic` constraint turns it into a direct dep, so a ceiling-only bound would let that leg drop to an *ancient* anthropic. Pin `anthropic>=<compatible-floor>,<<httpx2-vendoring-release>` matching what `uv.lock` resolves and what `pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic]` requires, so BOTH the macOS float leg and the lowest-direct floor leg land on a compatible SDK.

**Option (b) — the provider-seam adaptation to the httpx2 `http_client` contract — is split out to a new follow-up ticket and BLOCKED on eb64.** It touches `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:_build_retrying_anthropic_provider` (eb64 declared scope) and collides directly with the in-flight anthropic-backoff work (254e), which enhances that same retrying provider by passing a custom `httpx.AsyncClient` — exactly the seam (b) must rework. Sequencing (b) after eb64/254e also lets the cap this ticket adds be lifted once the seam is httpx2-compatible.

## RCA + fix (option (a), /rebar-debug Phase 2) — change up for Gerrit review

**Confirmed root cause (reproduced locally).** `pyproject.toml`'s `[agents]` extra declared `pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries,duckduckgo]>=1.107,<2` with **no direct bound on the `anthropic` SDK**. An unlocked resolve floats anthropic to its latest release; anthropic **1.0.0+** switched its client to a vendored `httpx2` and rejects a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient`. The provider seam `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:_build_retrying_anthropic_provider` (line ~155-157) constructs `AsyncAnthropic(..., http_client=httpx.AsyncClient(...))`, so under a floated SDK it raises `TypeError: Invalid http_client argument; Expected an instance of httpx2.AsyncClient but got <class 'httpx.AsyncClient'>`, cascading into ~90 failures. `uv.lock` (pins 0.121.0) masks it on the merge gate; only the unlocked mirror-sweep legs float.

**RED evidence (this session):**
- `uv pip compile` of `.[agents]` at BOTH highest and `--resolution lowest-direct` selected `anthropic==1.2.0` (+ `httpx2==2.12.0`) against the pre-fix pyproject.
- Under `anthropic==1.2.0`, `AsyncAnthropic(api_key=…, max_retries=0, http_client=httpx.AsyncClient())` raised the exact `TypeError` above; under `anthropic==0.121.0` it constructed cleanly (`max_retries=0`).

**httpx2 boundary — corrected from the ticket's initial "<1.2.0".** Verified against PyPI metadata: anthropic `1.0.0`, `1.1.0`, `1.2.0` **all** declare `httpx2<3,>=2.0.0`; every `0.x` through `0.125.0` declares stdlib `httpx<1,>=0.25.0`. The first httpx2-vendoring release is **1.0.0**, so the correct ceiling is **`<1`** (a `<1.2.0` ceiling would still admit the broken 1.0.0/1.1.0).

**Fix (pyproject + tests only):** added a direct `anthropic>=0.121.0,<1` to `[agents]`.
- **Ceiling `<1`** — strictly below the first httpx2 release, so no resolve can float onto the rejected client.
- **Floor `>=0.121.0`** is load-bearing, not cosmetic: the `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` leg uses `--resolution lowest-direct`, which pins a *direct* constraint to its floor. `>=0.121.0` matches what `uv.lock` resolves and satisfies pydantic-ai-slim's own `anthropic>=0.108.0`, so the floor leg lands on the verified SDK instead of dropping to an ancient one.
- **Post-fix resolutions:** highest → `anthropic==0.125.0`, lowest-direct → `anthropic==0.121.0` (both `0.x`, stdlib httpx). Both construct the provider without `TypeError`. (`httpx2` still appears in the tree — pulled by `genai-prices`, unrelated to anthropic — harmless; the break was anthropic *requiring* `httpx2.AsyncClient`, not its mere presence.)
- Regenerated `uv.lock` (minimal: adds the direct anthropic requires-dist edge; anthropic stays pinned 0.121.0) so CI's `--locked` Verified gate stays consistent.

**Defect origin (caused_by → 7d58-e88b-1643-4542, stun-ash-zeal).** This is an **omission**: no commit "broke" it — anthropic 1.0.0 vendored httpx2 externally. Story 7d58 introduced the uncapped `pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic]` dependency in commit `75e598a41e7c`; its declared scope is "pyproject.toml [agents] (add pydantic-ai-slim extras)" and its file_impact includes pyproject.toml, so bounding the SDK fell within its scope. `75e598a` predates the `rebar-ticket:` trailer convention (names "Story 7d58" in prose), so the caused_by data-integrity gate is commit-less here; recorded via the sanctioned `--force="scope-of-work attribution: …"` (that force is on the link gate, NOT a plan/close gate). Close class when the orchestrator closes: **preexisting** (a latent packaging omission that a later external SDK release activated; no rebar regression introduced it).

**RED→GREEN test (`tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py::test_anthropic_sdk_is_bounded_below_the_httpx2_line`).** A pure pyproject-parse oracle (portable: no network, no install, no CI-provider trigger). It parses the declared direct `anthropic` requirement and asserts its specifier admits `0.121.0` (locked, stdlib-httpx) and rejects `1.0.0`/`1.1.0`/`1.2.0` (httpx2). Shown **RED first** against the unbounded pyproject (no direct anthropic dep → `assert None is not None`), then **GREEN** after the fix. **Mutation teeth (sandboxed, macOS `sandbox-exec`):** removing the `<1` ceiling makes the specifier admit `1.0.0` → test returns **RED**; restored → GREEN. Not a change-detector (asserts the observable packaging contract, not private names). `make lint` clean.

**Scope confirmation — stayed out of eb64.** Diff is exactly `pyproject.toml` + `tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py` + `uv.lock`. Did **not** touch `src/rebar/llm/` (incl. `anthropic_model.py`), the reconciler, `_operation_config.py`, `_cli/`, `_commands/`, `_store/`, `.github/workflows/`, or `docs/adr/`. The provider-seam adaptation (option b) remains in follow-up `2bd6-ff87-d48c-4a65`.

**Sibling census (Step 7).** The construct is "a `pydantic-ai-slim[<provider>]` extra pulling an unbounded provider SDK." Parallel surfaces in pyproject: `pydantic-ai-slim[openai]` (unbounded `openai`), `pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]` (boto3). Not currently broken and out of this ticket's operator-approved scope: only the **anthropic** provider seam passes a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient` into a vendored-client SDK, and only anthropic legs are red. Flagged here for monitoring; not filed as confirmed siblings (unproven + would require touching provider seams that belong to eb64).

Leaving `1f35` **in_progress** — close waits on `Verified +1` + `LLM-Review +1` per the orchestrator.

## Problem

Surfaced while fixing `anatomical-arbored-oyster` (e3e0-2e7c-b280-4b4a). Once that fix removed the `FileNotFoundError` collection error (macOS leg) and the `license-files` build `TypeError` (floor leg), the `Test Suite (mirror)` legs run to completion and reveal a large, **pre-existing** failure class that was previously masked.

Dominant macOS-leg error (~90 failures across `test_provider_parity`, `test_transport_retry`, `test_llm_fallback_chain`, `test_llm_provider_factory`, `test_llm_timeouts`, `test_web_tool_gating`, `test_llm_config_gate_root`, ...):

```
Error: Invalid `http_client` argument; Expected an instance of `httpx2.AsyncClient` but got <class 'httpx.AsyncClient'>
```

## Root cause

`pyproject.toml` declares `pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries,duckduckgo]>=1.107,<2` but places **no upper bound on the `anthropic` SDK itself**. The mirror sweep installs UNLOCKED:
- `sweep (macos, full suite)`: `uv pip install '.[dev,reviewbot,ui]'` (non-editable)
- `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)`: `uv pip install --resolution lowest-direct '.[dev,agents]'`

Both resolve `anthropic==1.2.0`, whose client vendors `httpx2` and **rejects** a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient`. rebar's provider seam (`src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:_build_retrying_anthropic_provider` -> `anthropic/_client.py:__init__`) passes an `httpx.AsyncClient`, so construction raises `TypeError` and cascades into every Anthropic-touching test. The Verified merge gate is green because `uv.lock` pins an older, compatible anthropic (0.121.0); only the unlocked sweep legs float to 1.2.0.

**httpx2 boundary (verified against PyPI metadata):** the switch to the vendored `httpx2` client happened at anthropic **1.0.0**, not 1.2.0 — anthropic `1.0.0`, `1.1.0`, and `1.2.0` all declare `httpx2<3,>=2.0.0`, while every `0.x` release through `0.125.0` declares stdlib `httpx<1,>=0.25.0`. So the ceiling that excludes the httpx2 line is `<1`, i.e. strictly below `1.0.0`.

## Fix (option (a) — operator-approved, Decision 6): bound `anthropic` in pyproject

Add a DIRECT, bounded `anthropic` dependency to the `[agents]` extra: `anthropic>=0.121.0,<1`.

- **Ceiling `<1`** excludes the first httpx2-vendoring release (1.0.0) and everything above it, so no sweep resolution can float the SDK onto the httpx2 client the provider seam rejects.
- **Floor `>=0.121.0`** matches what `uv.lock` resolves and satisfies `pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic]`'s own `anthropic>=0.108.0` requirement. The floor is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: the `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` leg uses `--resolution lowest-direct`, and once `anthropic` is a *direct* constraint that leg pins it to the floor. A ceiling-only bound would let that leg drop to an ancient, incompatible anthropic and merely move the failure; `>=0.121.0` lands it on the same verified SDK as the lockfile.

This is the portable, minimal fix (a declared dependency constraint + a pure-parse packaging unit test — no CI-provider-specific machinery), entirely outside epic `financial-stoneware-brant` (eb64) scope, and it makes the declared bound honest about a known incompatibility `uv.lock` currently masks.

## Scope
- `pyproject.toml` — add `anthropic>=0.121.0,<1` to `[project.optional-dependencies].agents`.
- `tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py` — RED oracle asserting the declared `anthropic` bound admits the locked 0.121.0 and excludes the httpx2 releases (1.0.0, 1.2.0).

**Out of scope (do NOT touch):** `src/rebar/llm/` (incl. `anthropic_model.py`), the reconciler, CLI/commands, store, workflows, ADRs — all eb64 territory. Option (b) (adapt the provider seam to the httpx2 `http_client` contract) is split to follow-up `2bd6-ff87-d48c-4a65`, BLOCKED on eb64/254e.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] `pyproject.toml`'s `[agents]` extra declares a DIRECT `anthropic` dependency with BOTH a floor and a ceiling; the ceiling excludes the httpx2-vendoring line (`<1`).
- [x] A packaging unit test asserts the declared `anthropic` specifier admits `0.121.0` (locked, stdlib-httpx) and rejects `1.0.0` and `1.2.0` (httpx2); it fails RED if the ceiling is removed.
- [x] A fresh resolution of `.[agents]` — both highest-version AND `--resolution lowest-direct` — resolves `anthropic` to a `0.x` (stdlib-httpx) release, so the Anthropic provider constructs without the `Invalid http_client ... httpx2.AsyncClient` `TypeError`.
- [x] The fix is portable across CI providers / no CI (a declared dependency constraint + a pure pyproject-parse test; no CI-system-specific trigger).

## Evidence
- Mirror run 33299427686 (dispatched on `main` post-fix): `sweep (macos, full suite)` job 99224621948, `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` job 99224621821. `anthropic==1.2.0` shown installing in the macOS leg; error string above aggregated 90x.
- Local RED repro (this session): `uv pip compile` of `.[agents]` at both highest and `lowest-direct` resolutions selects `anthropic==1.2.0` + `httpx2==2.12.0`; constructing `AsyncAnthropic(http_client=httpx.AsyncClient())` under anthropic 1.2.0 raises the exact `TypeError`; under `anthropic==0.121.0` it constructs cleanly.
